policy: A re-freeze is an owner-authorised change of one component pin to a remediation commit. The original freeze-manifest.json is never edited; results obtained at the original pin are retained as historical evidence and are never relabelled. A verdict applies to the subject as re-frozen only after a full controller run at the new pins.
